name: Omni La Costa Resort
positioning: Omni La Costa Resort & Spa: a 400-acre Spanish Mission-style golf, spa and pool resort in Carlsbad, north of San Diego
best_for: Golfers who want two courses on the property
Families wanting kids programming and a choice of pools
Travelers combining spa time and tennis with San Diego sightseeing

facts.text: Omni La Costa Resort & Spa is a 400-acre Spanish Mission-style property north of San Diego.
The resort is in Carlsbad, California, at 2100 Costa Del Mar Road.
The resort completed a multi-million dollar renovation in spring 2024.
The resort was a celebrity retreat in the 1960s.
The landscaping features palm trees, bougainvillea and fountains.
The resort has eight swimming pools.
The spa offers massages, specialty skincare and salon services.
The resort has tennis and pickleball courts.
Suites come in one-, two- and three-bedroom configurations.
Junior Suites have a sitting area with a queen-size sofa bed and an oversized bathroom.
A Spanish-style shopping plaza on the grounds includes a golf and tennis pro shop.
The resort's restaurants include dining overlooking the fairways and a venue for steak and seafood.

highlights.text: The resort offers 36 holes of golf on its North and South Courses, each offering a distinct experience.
The residential-style villas update the Spanish Revival style.
Golf View Rooms are close to the golf courses and have course views.
The Spa at La Costa offers massages, specialty skincare and salon services.
At Kidtopia Kids Club, children can play, do arts and crafts and watch movies.

considerations.text: A daily resort fee applies; it includes 24/7 on-property shuttle access.
The resort is in Carlsbad, north of San Diego, rather than in the city of San Diego itself.
WhataHotel notes the property is large, so getting around means walking or using the shuttle.
